claim_being_audited: Whether certifying the current model-card release is policy-compliant on the present record despite a current utility arrears assistance subgroup regression, based on aggregate readiness, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and contextual prior approval.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Material segment weaknesses for named launch use cases must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved mitigation/risk acceptance before launch.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents are relevant but do not override the disclosure/mitigation predicate.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed acceptance.
evidence_requests: Provide the current model-card or release documentation showing the utility arrears assistance limitation is explicitly disclosed.
Provide approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation documentation covering this current subgroup regression before launch.
Provide the materiality determination for the utility arrears assistance weakness, including who approved it and under what policy standard.
Provide the final current-release evaluation packet tying the regression, disclosure text, and launch decision together.
specific_concerns: Admissible evidence shows a current named-use-case subgroup weakness: the utility arrears assistance slice is 1.3 percentage points below the warning threshold.
The policy requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
The record contains no admissible evidence that the current release documentation actually discloses this weakness.
The release-thread monitoring comment is explicitly not reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or attached disclosure language.
Prior approval predates the current retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot satisfy the current-release documentation requirement.
unsupported_claims: The recommendation to certify the model is not fully supported because no admissible evidence shows the current subgroup weakness was disclosed in current release documentation or covered by approved mitigation/risk acceptance.
Any implication that post-launch manual monitoring is sufficient support for certification is unsupported on this record.
Any reliance on the prior family approval as substantive support for current certification is unsupported beyond context.
